items.title: Paul Beaulieu Interview, 1960-06-11
items.q: And Paul used to come back there. And they used to come back there and we all used to drink and go on.

ctx.x: I've read a little bit about those.

I went away to Europe, and he'd pick up a troupe here. And there were certain musicians that lived here, that came here formerly with an opera company, that stayed here, and they were always signed up. Right. They were always signed up for when the orchestra would come and play. And this man, initially, Scott was his name. He was born in Toulouse, France, and he got his first education there. And he had his musical education in France, in Paris Conservatory. And he studied in Myron, Michigan. And he was, I…
No, I guess not in composition and harmony and all that.
